verses.greek: Τοιγαροῦν καὶ ἡμεῖς, τοσοῦτον ἔχοντες περικείμενον ἡμῖν νέφος μαρτύρων, ὄγκον ἀποθέμενοι πάντα καὶ τὴν εὐπερίστατον ἁμαρτίαν, διʼ ὑπομονῆς τρέχωμεν τὸν προκείμενον ἡμῖν ἀγῶνα,
verses.literal: Therefore also we ourselves such a great having encompassing us a cloud of witnesses weight having laid aside every and the easily entangling sin with endurance may run the lying before us race
verses.dgt: Therefore, since we also have so great a cloud of witnesses surrounding us, let us lay aside every weight and the sin that so easily entangles, and let us run with endurance the race set before us,

verses.greek: ἀφορῶντες εἰς τὸν τῆς πίστεως ἀρχηγὸν καὶ τελειωτὴν Ἰησοῦν, ὃς ἀντὶ τῆς προκειμένης αὐτῷ χαρᾶς ὑπέμεινεν σταυρὸν αἰσχύνης καταφρονήσας, ἐν δεξιᾷ τε τοῦ θρόνου τοῦ θεοῦ κεκάθικεν.
verses.literal: looking to the the of our faith founder and perfecter Jesus who in view of what is lying before Him joy endured the cross its shame having despised at right hand and of the throne the of God has sat down.
verses.dgt: looking to Jesus, the founder and perfecter of faith, who for the joy set before him endured a cross, despising shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

verses.greek: Ἀναλογίσασθε γὰρ τὸν τοιαύτην ὑπομεμενηκότα ὑπὸ τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν εἰς ἑαυτοὺς ἀντιλογίαν, ἵνα μὴ κάμητε ταῖς ψυχαῖς ὑμῶν ἐκλυόμενοι.
verses.literal: do consider fully for the One such great having endured from the sinners against ἑαυτοὺς hostility so that not you may grow weary in the souls of you fainting.
verses.dgt: For consider the one who endured such hostility against himself from sinners, so that you may not grow weary and lose heart.

verses.greek: οὔπω μέχρις αἵματος ἀντικατέστητε πρὸς τὴν ἁμαρτίαν ἀνταγωνιζόμενοι,
verses.literal: Not yet unto blood have you resisted against the sin struggling
verses.dgt: You have not yet resisted to the point of blood in your struggle against sin,

verses.greek: καὶ ἐκλέλησθε τῆς παρακλήσεως, ἥτις ὑμῖν ὡς υἱοῖς διαλέγεται, Υἱέ μου, μὴ ὀλιγώρει παιδείας κυρίου, μηδὲ ἐκλύου ὑπʼ αὐτοῦ ἐλεγχόμενος·
verses.literal: and you have forgotten the exhortation that you as to sons addresses: Son of Mine not do regard lightly the discipline of the Lord nor do faint by Him being reproved.
verses.dgt: and you have forgotten the encouragement that addresses you as sons: “My son, do not regard lightly the Lord’s discipline, nor lose heart when reproved by him,

verses.greek: ὃν γὰρ ἀγαπᾷ κύριος παιδεύει, μαστιγοῖ δὲ πάντα υἱὸν ὃν παραδέχεται.
verses.literal: Whom for He loves the Lord disciplines He scourges now every son whom He receives.
verses.dgt: for the Lord disciplines the one he loves, and he scourges every son whom he receives.”

verses.greek: εἰς παιδείαν ὑπομένετε· ὡς υἱοῖς ὑμῖν προσφέρεται ὁ θεός· τίς γὰρ υἱὸς ὃν οὐ παιδεύει πατήρ;
verses.literal: As discipline endure as sons you is treating the God what for son is there whom not disciplines his father?
verses.dgt: Endure for discipline. God deals with you as sons, for what son is there whom a father does not discipline?

verses.greek: εἰ δὲ χωρίς ἐστε παιδείας ἧς μέτοχοι γεγόνασι πάντες, ἄρα νόθοι καὶ οὐχ υἱοί ἐστε.
verses.literal: If however without you are of discipline of which partakers they have become all then illegitimate children and not sons you are.
verses.dgt: But if you are without discipline, of which all have become sharers, then you are illegitimate children and not sons.

verses.greek: εἶτα τοὺς μὲν τῆς σαρκὸς ἡμῶν πατέρας εἴχομεν παιδευτὰς καὶ ἐνετρεπόμεθα· οὐ πολὺ μᾶλλον ὑποταγησόμεθα τῷ πατρὶ τῶν πνευμάτων καὶ ζήσομεν;
verses.literal: Furthermore the indeed of the flesh of us fathers we were having correctors and we were respecting them not much more will we be in subjection to the Father the of spirits and will live?
verses.dgt: Furthermore, we had our earthly fathers as disciplinarians and respected them. Shall we not much more be subject to the Father of spirits and live?

verses.greek: οἱ μὲν γὰρ πρὸς ὀλίγας ἡμέρας κατὰ τὸ δοκοῦν αὐτοῖς ἐπαίδευον, ὁ δὲ ἐπὶ τὸ συμφέρον εἰς τὸ μεταλαβεῖν τῆς ἁγιότητος αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: the Indeed for during a few days according to which is seeming good to them they were disciplining us He however for which is our benefitting in order the to share of the holiness of Him.
verses.dgt: For they disciplined us for a few days as seemed best to them, but he does so for our benefit, so that we may share his holiness.

verses.greek: πᾶσα δὲ παιδεία πρὸς μὲν τὸ παρὸν οὐ δοκεῖ χαρᾶς εἶναι ἀλλὰ λύπης, ὕστερον δὲ καρπὸν εἰρηνικὸν τοῖς διʼ αὐτῆς γεγυμνασμένοις ἀποδίδωσιν δικαιοσύνης.
verses.literal: All now discipline for indeed those being present not it seems of joy to be but of grief afterward however the fruit peaceable to those through it trained it yields of righteousness.
verses.dgt: Now all discipline for the moment does not seem to be joy but sorrow, yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those trained through it.

verses.greek: Διὸ τὰς παρειμένας χεῖρας καὶ τὰ παραλελυμένα γόνατα ἀνορθώσατε,
verses.literal: Therefore the drooped hands and the enfeebled knees do lift up
verses.dgt: Therefore strengthen the drooping hands and the weakened knees,

verses.greek: καὶ τροχιὰς ὀρθὰς ποιεῖτε τοῖς ποσὶν ὑμῶν, ἵνα μὴ τὸ χωλὸν ἐκτραπῇ, ἰαθῇ δὲ μᾶλλον.
verses.literal: and paths straight do make for the feet of you so that not the lame may be disabled may be healed however rather.
verses.dgt: and make straight paths for your feet, so that what is lame may not be put out of joint but rather be healed.

verses.greek: Εἰρήνην διώκετε μετὰ πάντων, καὶ τὸν ἁγιασμόν, οὗ χωρὶς οὐδεὶς ὄψεται τὸν κύριον,
verses.literal: Peace do pursue with all and the holiness which without no one will behold the Lord
verses.dgt: Pursue peace with everyone, and holiness, without which no one will see the Lord,

verses.greek: ἐπισκοποῦντες μή τις ὑστερῶν ἀπὸ τῆς χάριτος τοῦ θεοῦ, μή τις ῥίζα πικρίας ἄνω φύουσα ἐνοχλῇ καὶ διʼ αὐτῆς μιανθῶσιν πολλοί,
verses.literal: observing lest any be failing of the grace the of God lest any root of bitterness up springing may trouble you and through this may be defiled many
verses.dgt: watching carefully so that no one falls short of the grace of God, so that no root of bitterness grows up and causes trouble and through it many are defiled,

verses.greek: μή τις πόρνος ἢ βέβηλος ὡς Ἠσαῦ, ὃς ἀντὶ βρώσεως μιᾶς ἀπέδετο τὰ πρωτοτόκια ἑαυτοῦ.
verses.literal: lest there be any fornicator or profane person as Esau who for meal one sold the birthright of himself.
verses.dgt: so that no one is sexually immoral or profane like Esau, who for a single meal sold his own birthright.

verses.greek: ἴστε γὰρ ὅτι καὶ μετέπειτα θέλων κληρονομῆσαι τὴν εὐλογίαν ἀπεδοκιμάσθη, μετανοίας γὰρ τόπον οὐχ εὗρεν, καίπερ μετὰ δακρύων ἐκζητήσας αὐτήν.
verses.literal: You know for that even afterward wishing to inherit the blessing he was rejected of repentance for place not he found although with tears having earnestly sought it.
verses.dgt: For you know that even afterward, when he wanted to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for repentance, although he sought it with tears.

verses.greek: Οὐ γὰρ προσεληλύθατε ψηλαφωμένῳ καὶ κεκαυμένῳ πυρὶ καὶ γνόφῳ καὶ ζόφῳ καὶ θυέλλῃ
verses.literal: Not for you have come to that being touched and kindled with fire and to darkness and to gloom and to storm
verses.dgt: For you have not come to something that can be touched and to blazing fire and darkness and gloom and storm,

verses.greek: καὶ σάλπιγγος ἤχῳ καὶ φωνῇ ῥημάτων, ἧς οἱ ἀκούσαντες παρῃτήσαντο μὴ προστεθῆναι αὐτοῖς λόγον·
verses.literal: and of a trumpet to the sound and to a voice of declaration which those having heard they excused themselves asking not to be addressed to them the word
verses.dgt: and to the sound of a trumpet and a voice of words, which those who heard begged that no further word be spoken to them,

verses.greek: οὐκ ἔφερον γὰρ τὸ διαστελλόμενον· Κἂν θηρίον θίγῃ τοῦ ὄρους, λιθοβοληθήσεται·
verses.literal: not able they were bearing for which is being commanded: If even a beast shall touch the mountain it will be stoned
verses.dgt: for they could not bear what was commanded: “Even if an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned.”

verses.greek: καί, οὕτω φοβερὸν ἦν τὸ φανταζόμενον, Μωϋσῆς εἶπεν· Ἔκφοβός εἰμι καὶ ἔντρομος.
verses.literal: And thus fearful was the thing appearing that Moses said Greatly afraid I am and trembling
verses.dgt: And so terrifying was the sight that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”

verses.greek: ἀλλὰ προσεληλύθατε Σιὼν ὄρει καὶ πόλει θεοῦ ζῶντος, Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἐπουρανίῳ, καὶ μυριάσιν ἀγγέλων, πανηγύρει
verses.literal: But you have come to Zion Mount and to the city of God the living to Jerusalem the heavenly and to myriads of angels 23 to the assembly
verses.dgt: But you have come to Mount Zion and the city of the living God, heavenly Jerusalem, and to myriads of angels in festal gathering,

verses.greek: καὶ ἐκκλησίᾳ πρωτοτόκων ἀπογεγραμμένων ἐν οὐρανοῖς, καὶ κριτῇ θεῷ πάντων, καὶ πνεύμασι δικαίων τετελειωμένων,
verses.literal: and to the church of the firstborn enrolled in the heavens and to the judge God of all and to the spirits of the righteous perfected
verses.dgt: and to the assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, and to God, Judge of all, and to the spirits of righteous people made perfect,

verses.greek: καὶ διαθήκης νέας μεσίτῃ Ἰησοῦ, καὶ αἵματι ῥαντισμοῦ κρεῖττον λαλοῦντι παρὰ τὸν Ἅβελ.
verses.literal: and of a covenant new the mediator to Jesus and to the blood of sprinkling better thing speaking than that of Abel.
verses.dgt: and to Jesus, mediator of a new covenant, and to sprinkled blood that speaks better than Abel’s.

verses.greek: Βλέπετε μὴ παραιτήσησθε τὸν λαλοῦντα· εἰ γὰρ ἐκεῖνοι οὐκ ἐξέφυγον ἐπὶ γῆς παραιτησάμενοι τὸν χρηματίζοντα, πολὺ μᾶλλον ἡμεῖς οἱ τὸν ἀπʼ οὐρανῶν ἀποστρεφόμενοι·
verses.literal: do take heed lest you may refuse the One speaking If for they not escaped on the having refused the One divinely instructing them much less we ourselves the the One from the heavens turning away from
verses.dgt: See that you do not refuse the one who speaks. For if those did not escape when they refused the one who warned them on earth, much less will we if we turn away from the one from heaven.

verses.greek: οὗ ἡ φωνὴ τὴν γῆν ἐσάλευσεν τότε, νῦν δὲ ἐπήγγελται λέγων· Ἔτι ἅπαξ ἐγὼ σείσω οὐ μόνον τὴν γῆν ἀλλὰ καὶ τὸν οὐρανόν.
verses.literal: whose the voice the earth shook at that time now however He has promised saying Yet once more I myself will shake not only the earth but also the heaven.
verses.dgt: At that time his voice shook the earth, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth but also heaven.”

verses.greek: τὸ δὲ Ἔτι ἅπαξ δηλοῖ τῶν σαλευομένων μετάθεσιν ὡς πεποιημένων, ἵνα μείνῃ τὰ μὴ σαλευόμενα.
verses.literal: This now Yet once more signifies that being shaken removing as created so that may remain the things not being shaken.
verses.dgt: And the phrase “yet once more” indicates the removal of the things being shaken as things that have been made, so that the things not shaken may remain.

verses.greek: διὸ βασιλείαν ἀσάλευτον παραλαμβάνοντες ἔχωμεν χάριν, διʼ ἧς λατρεύωμεν εὐαρέστως τῷ θεῷ μετὰ εὐλαβείας καὶ δέους,
verses.literal: Therefore a kingdom not to be shaken receiving we may have grace through which we may serve well pleasingly the God with reverence and fear
verses.dgt: Therefore, since we are receiving an unshakable kingdom, let us have gratitude, through which we may serve God acceptably with reverence and awe,

verses.greek: καὶ γὰρ ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν πῦρ καταναλίσκον.
verses.literal: Also for the God of us is a fire consuming.
verses.dgt: for our God is a consuming fire.
